meta.name: state-strengthening-reform-strategy
meta.description: Use when implementing comprehensive reforms to strengthen a state's governance and external position. Combines internal reforms (legal codification, agriculture/weaving promotion, military readiness) with external horizontal alliance strategy (连衡) from Shang Yang's model.

copy.tagline: 制定并实施国家治理与外交改革策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟或历史情境中设计国家改革方案
copy.tagline_en: Design and implement state governance and diplomatic reform strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design state reform plans in simulation or historical contexts

howto.what: Claude会按照商鞅模型，先实施内部改革（法律、农业、军事），再执行外部连横策略，鼓励对手冲突，最终加强国家治理和扩张。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行全面的国家改革以强化治理和外部地位时触发。

say.text: 请帮我制定提升国家军事和经济实力的改革方案。
如何通过外交手段削弱邻国？
我想实施法律修订和农业促进。

howto.what_en: Claude follows Shang Yang's model: first internal reforms (legal, agriculture, military), then external horizontal alliances to encourage rival conflicts, ultimately strengthening governance and expansion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for comprehensive state reforms to strengthen governance and external position.

say_en.text: Please help me design a reform plan to enhance national military and economic strength.
How to weaken neighboring states through diplomacy?
I want to implement legal revisions and agriculture promotion.
